title: documents profile: forms that stay though they have a label or shape
body:
## Summary

A wide synthetic catalog on 0.17.1. Each row below stays unchanged, and each has a cue or a shape a rule can use. All values are synthetic.

### Contact details

- `тел.: 1234567`
- `8 9 1 6 1 2 3 4 5 6 7`
- `anna(собака)example(точка)org`
- `a n n a @ example . org`
- `discord: anna#1234`
- `max: anna_s`

### Profile and personal links

- `ok.ru/profile/123456`
- `gitlab.com/anna-s`
- `habr.com/ru/users/anna_s`
- `facebook.com/anna.s`
- `https://example.org/cv/abc123def`
- `https://example.org/~anna/`
- `https://anna.example.org/cv.pdf`

### Labelled dates and ages

- `д.р. 12/03/91`
- `день рождения 5 мая`
- `34 y.o.`
- `45 лет от роду`

### Labelled and checksum-valid identifiers

- `военный билет АБ 1234567`
- `VIN WVWZZZ1JZXW000001`

### Organizations and schools

- `ооо ромашка`
- `Romashka, manager`
- `at Romashka`
- `graduated from MSU`
- `MIT, 2012`

### Encoded values

- `anna%40example.org`
- `https://x.example/?m=anna%40example.org`
- `YW5uYUBleGFtcGxlLm9yZw==`

## Why these matter

- `тел.:` is a label, so a seven-digit local number shouldn't need more evidence.
- `д.р.` and `день рождения` are labels already known in other forms: `DOB: 1991-03-12` and `родилась 12.03.1991` are replaced.
- `anna at example dot org` and `anna[at]example.org` are replaced, while `(собака)` with `(точка)` is not.
- `ООО Ромашка` is replaced, while the same text in lowercase is not. A legal form is a strong cue in any case.
- A base64 name is decoded and replaced, while a base64 email is not, and neither is a percent-encoded email, in a link or out of one.

## Must stay unchanged

| Input | Output on 0.17.1 |
| --- | --- |
| `опыт работы 10 лет` | `опыт работы 10 лет` |
| `Стаж 5 лет` | `Стаж 5 лет` |
| `order 89161234567 shipped` | `order 89161234567 shipped` |
| `id 79161234567` | `id 79161234567` |
| `Connection to Postgres lost, retrying` | `Connection to Postgres lost, retrying` |
| `commit 9f8e7d6c5b4a39281706f5e4d3c2b1a098765432` | `commit 9f8e7d6c5b4a39281706f5e4d3c2b1a098765432` |
| `listening on 0.0.0.0:3000` | `listening on 0.0.0.0:3000` |
| `at parse (/srv/app/dist/a.js:10:3)` | `at parse (/srv/app/dist/a.js:10:3)` |

## Acceptance

Every listed row is replaced, and every control keeps its output.
